company.name: HelixNano
company.shortDescription: Helix Nanotechnologies uses artificial intelligence to help cure genetic diseases.
company.description: Helix Nanotechnologies uses artificial intelligence to help cure genetic diseases. HelixNano is a Y Combinator and venture backed biotech startup. At HelixNano, we have spent the last two years developing cancer vaccines. Now we are adapting our synthetic biology arsenal to take on COVID-19. We’re moving fast but thinking long-term. We’re already testing COVID-19 vaccine candidates designed to be precise and safe. Our next goal is to create a vaccine that protects everyone not only from this virus, but all future coronaviruses.

aiResearchSummary.text: HelixNano is researching RNA manufacturing and delivery, focusing on promoter proximal sequences that improve polyribonucleotide yield and purity in Promoter proximal sequences and uses thereof for RNA manufacturing, and on optimized in vitro transcription in Compositions and methods for RNA synthesis. It is also developing modified ribonucleic acids and cap compounds with acetylated ribose in Acetylated ribonucleic acids and uses thereof and Cap compounds and RNAs comprising the same. These efforts span RNA synthesis, modification, and delivery technologies.
